_comment: Veklom MCP Server — mount this in Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any MCP-compatible IDE.

veklom-income-orchestrator._comment: STDIO mode: runs server.py as a local subprocess (dev / laptop use)

veklom-income-orchestrator-sse._comment: SSE mode: connect to your live Hetzner deployment over HTTP

_deployment_notes: 1. Set MCP_TRANSPORT=sse in Coolify and expose port 8000.
2. Replace YOUR_HETZNER_DOMAIN with your actual Coolify subdomain.
3. Replace YOUR_VEKLOM_API_KEY with the JWT from /api/v1/auth/login.
4. In Cursor: Settings → MCP → paste the veklom-income-orchestrator-sse block.
5. In Claude Desktop: add to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
